address: Alte Arlbergstraße 2, Sankt Anton am Arlberg, 6580, Austria
bio: Alpine Soul – Japanese Spirit – Nordic Air is the philosophy of the fine dining restaurant in the Ullrhaus designer hotel. This cosmopolitan approach is reflected in modern, creative dishes such as essence of shellfish, king crab, taco, tomatillo or Miéral pigeon, beetroot, purple shiso, plum umeboshi, which are a true delight, thanks to remarkably precise craftsmanship and punchy flavours. Components are skilfully balanced, and the quality of the ingredients is top-notch. The fantastic nine-course set menu is accompanied by a high-calibre wine selection with a focus on Austria, Italy and France, including some major names. The space, in which diners are seated at four large tables, has a sophisticated feel, with the warmth of Scandinavian-style wood and decorative green tiles on the walls...
